name: Lonely Christmas: Sadistic Santa
source:
You're feeling a bit down as you're spending your first Christmas alone, but (luckily?) you realize that you've been assigned a sexy personal Santa that has to obey you until Christmas is over, except...she's a cruel sadist that won't stop insulting you with a disgusted face.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3388570/Lonely_Christmas_Sadistic_Santa/?curator_clanid=45331749] Steam[/url]]
translation:
第一次孤身一人度过圣诞节让你心情有些低落，但（幸运的是？）你发现自己分到了一位性感的专属圣诞老人，在圣诞节结束前她都必须对你唯命是从——只不过……她是个残酷的施虐狂，总是摆出一副嫌弃恶心的表情对你骂个不停。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3388570/Lonely_Christmas_Sadistic_Santa/?curator_clanid=45331749]Steam[/url]]
